title: Live Lesson - URL uses new redirect format when ImproveSSO flag is ON
description: URL/Auth case for new redirect format.
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Feature flag User_Authentication_ImproveSSO is ON.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe opened redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. Redirect URL follows new format and data is valid by tenant rule.

title: Live Lesson - URL uses legacy format when ImproveSSO flag is OFF
description: URL/Auth case for legacy redirect format.
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Feature flag User_Authentication_ImproveSSO is OFF.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe opened redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL follows legacy format and should NOT use new redirect format.

title: Live Lesson - JPREP URL has correct structure and should NOT contain double slash
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson exists in JPREP tenant; Start Lesson is visible and clickable.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson in JPREP; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe redirect URL in destination tab.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL matches JPREP structure and must NOT contain double slash in path.

title: Live Lesson - URL contains user_id parameter according to tenant rule
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Tenant requires user_id in redirect URL.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson; 3. Observe query parameters in redirect URL.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed successfully; 3. URL contains user_id for teacher identity and must NOT be empty.

title: Live Lesson - With pop-up blocker enabled the system shows guidance or fallback
preconditions: Teacher is logged in to BackOffice; An online lesson in BO Calendar shows Start Lesson; Browser pop-up blocker is ON.
steps_actions: 1. Open BO Calendar lesson detail panel (right panel) for an online lesson; 2. Click Start Lesson while pop-up blocker is ON; 3. Observe guidance message or fallback behavior.
steps_result: 1. BO Calendar lesson detail panel opens successfully; 2. Click action is executed; 3. System shows guidance/fallback as designed and must NOT crash/show blank screen.
